# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge is short and sharp: act like men. In a world that often rewards comfort and passivity, this verse calls us to something higher. The Greek word for "act like men" carries the idea of courage—of stepping up when it would be easier to step back. Notice the order: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Strength isn't the starting point; it's the result of vigilance and conviction. You can't be strong in the faith if you're not watching for the enemy's schemes. You can't stand firm if you've never decided what you're standing on. Every day is a battlefield, and the battle begins before your feet hit the floor. Will you drift through today reacting to whatever comes, or will you rise with intention—praying, watching, and standing on God's truth? Strength isn't something you wait to feel. It's something you choose, one decision at a time, trusting God to supply what you lack.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups. On each rep, say the phrase "Stand firm." Let your body remind your heart what you're called to do today.
